text:
Type: solid pine dining bench
Use: seating along a dining table, extra seating in a hallway; dining room, kitchen, hallway
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: solid pine with visible knots, untreated natural finish
Colors: light natural pine, warm honey
Shape: long plank seat with a deep apron, four tapered square legs, simple straight edges, long and low, light visual weight
Feel: warm, natural, relaxed, honest
Goes with: pine or oak tables, white walls, linen, black accents; rustic, farmhouse or Scandinavian dining rooms

product.name: NORNS
product.description: Solid pine is a natural material which ages beautifully and gains its own unique character over time.
